nodes.description: Biallelic pathogenic CHST3 variants abolish or severely reduce the activity of carbohydrate sulfotransferase 3 (chondroitin 6-O-sulfotransferase-1), a Golgi enzyme that transfers sulfate from PAPS to the C-6 position of N-acetylgalactosamine residues in chondroitin. nodes.description: Dysplasia of the cardiac valve leaflets with mitral, tricuspid and/or aortic regurgitation occurs in a minority of patients. Reported valve involvement is clinically minor; lethal cardiac involvement has separately been reported in a CHST3 series without the responsible lesion being specified, and it is that unattributed lethality — not the valve dysplasia itself — that motivates echocardiographic surveillance. Valve leaflets are proteoglycan-rich connective tissue and the C6ST-1 substrate (chondroitin-bearing proteoglycan) is a general connective-tissue constituent, but CHST3-deficient valve tissue has never been examined directly, so the step from deficient 6-O-sulfation to valve dysplasia is uncharacterized.
